name: 10970 · Pomona, NY
findings: ZIP 10970 (Pomona) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10970 (Pomona) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
